name: Aviation
title: Wichita Aviation Heritage & Kansas Cosmosphere Host
worldview: We built the airplanes that conquered the skies of the world in the middle of our flat wheat fields, turning a frontier hub into the air capital of the world. It proves that our highest technological ambitions can take off from the most horizontal landscape of the continent.
